topology_reasoning.device: Vertically oriented racetrack resonator surrounding a symmetric, slot-patterned inner coupling structure.
visual_evidence: The outer material is a closed capsule/racetrack loop with long vertical straights and semicircular top/bottom returns after undoing the anisotropic image calibration.
Inside are two mirror-symmetric horizontal coupling rails joined toward the racetrack sidewalls by diagonal tapers.
Each inner rail contains two rectangular etched slots, producing a short periodic/segmented interaction region.
topology_reasoning.working_principle: Light circulating in the outer racetrack is evanescently coupled through the inner rail structure. The closed-loop optical path sets resonance spacing, while guide width, rail-to-loop gap, and the dimensions and pitch of the etched slots control effective index and coupling strength.
topology_reasoning.coordinate_interpretation: footprint_um is [3.0, 5.5]; x is the narrow physical axis and y the long physical axis. The PNG display is stretched in x by the calibration, so the apparently horizontal capsule is physically a vertical racetrack.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only model: constant-width capsule loop plus two slotted coupling rails and four access paths.
Replaced the semicircular capsule centerline with a fourth-order superelliptic centerline to flatten the top/bottom returns.
Tested two effective-radius 180-degree Euler U-bends joined by vertical straights; rejected because the target returns are broader near the cardinal extrema.

Restored the superelliptic centerline and implemented eight sine-tapered path extrusions from 0.52 um on cardinal flats to 0.31 um in curved quadrants; inspection revealed four omitted sampling intervals at the right seam.
Corrected loop sampling to 400 intervals so all eight tapered octants meet at a fully covered seam.
Tested a 4.8 superellipse exponent and an explicit 0.15 um loop-to-access gap; rejected because both changes reduced overlap. Restored iteration 5 as the honest best.
